name: Ironband's Excavation
summary: In Thelsamar, Jern Hornhelm worries over the slow work at Ironband's Excavation. Supplies still reach Prospector Ironband's team, but reports show little progress. Jern trusts Ironband's diligence and sends you to learn what has disrupted the dig.

sections.title: A Slowdown in the Foothills
sections.body: Jern Hornhelm watches shipments from Thelsamar cross Loch Modan to the Explorers' League. Provisions and tools arrive steadily, yet Prospector Ironband's dig makes little progress. Jern knows Ironband as an upright, diligent dwarf, so he suspects something has disrupted the work. He sends you to find out what is holding the team back.

sections.title: The Trogg Infestation
sections.body: Explorer Magmar Fellhew tells you that violent troggs have overrun the excavation in the eastern hills. They harass the dwarven crew and scatter the team's discoveries. The League cannot study the ancient stones until the intruders are driven back.

faq.q: Who sends you to Ironband's Excavation?
faq.answer: Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar asks you to check on the excavation. Regular deliveries continue, but progress remains slow, so he wants someone there to investigate.

faq.q: Where is the excavation site located?
faq.answer: The excavation lies in the foothills east of the loch. From Thelsamar, skirt the southern end of the water and follow the path east into the hills.
Magmar Fellhew is an explorer assisting Prospector Ironband at the dig. He oversees its daily work and logistics, and explains the situation to messengers from Thelsamar.

faq.q: Why has progress stalled at the dig?
faq.answer: Aggressive troggs have halted the expedition. They surged into the ruins, disrupted the excavation, and forced the League to focus on defending itself.

faq.q: What comes next after completing this quest?
faq.answer: Magmar Fellhew directs you to help the team reclaim what was lost. The work continues with Gathering Idols, recovering relics stolen by the troggs.

faq.q: What is the Explorers' League looking for here?
faq.answer: Prospector Ironband's expedition seeks ancient relics and stonework beneath Loch Modan. The discoveries may shed light on dwarven history and their long-lost origins.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know each dig in Khaz Modan helps uncover the truth of dwarven ancestry and Titan heritage. Ironforge depends on Ironband's crew remaining safe.
As an Alliance member, you help secure Loch Modan by keeping its trade roads and research sites clear of subterranean trogg tribes.
